timeline.title_ja: Gemini 4 Carbon 発表 — サイバー防御重視、当面は限定提供
timeline.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon announced — cyber-defense focus, limited access for now
timeline.desc_ja:
提供段階: GAではなく限定提供（発表のみ）。公式逐語は「Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program」。開発者・企業・消費者向けは「as soon as possible」＝未提供で、米政府の事前検証プロセスに参加中と明記。
料金: 未掲載。Google公式料金ページ（ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing）に Gemini 4 Carbon の行はなく、2026-11-03時点で確認できた Gemini 4 系の行は Gemini 4 Argon のみ。ブログには予告として「will launch at the same introductory price as Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens priced at 95% off input token price」、脚注で導入期間終了後は入力$4.00／出力$20.00と記載。ただし料金ページに未掲載のため確定価格としては扱わない。
ベンチ: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 で59・1位（Artificial Analysisの指標）。SEC-bench Pro 88.2%（sec-bench）・ExploitGym 54.8%（sunblaze-ucb/exploitgym）・CWE-bench 71.0%（Collinear）はいずれも外部ベンチで、公式は「evaluated without guardrails」（ガードレール無しの評価）と明記。WebDev Arenaは1768で4位（+89 elo）。「Argon比で安全なコード生成の成功率2倍超」「Chromeチームが他社フラッグシップ比10倍超のパッチ品質」はGoogle社内・提携先の主張。
未公表: APIモデル名・コンテキスト長・出力上限・知識カットオフ・段階課金は当該ブログに記載が無いため、確認できるまで当サイトでは書かない。料金未掲載（予告 $2.00/$10.00）
timeline.desc_en:
Availability: limited access, not GA. Verbatim: "Starting this week, we will make Carbon available to a subset of cyber defenders and will gradually phase access to additional trusted partners through our Fairwind Program." Access for developers, businesses and consumers is "as soon as possible" i.e. not available yet; Google says it is taking part in the U.S. government's voluntary pre-release testing process.
Price: not listed. Google's official pricing page (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing) has no Gemini 4 Carbon row; as of Nov 3, 2026 the only Gemini 4 row there is Gemini 4 Argon. The blog announces a launch price: "will launch at the same introductory price as Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens priced at 95% off input token price", with a footnote adding $4.00 input / $20.00 output after the introductory period. We do not treat these as shipping prices.
Benchmarks: #1 at 59 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (Artificial Analysis's own index). SEC-bench Pro 88.2% (sec-bench), ExploitGym 54.8% (sunblaze-ucb/exploitgym) and CWE-bench 71.0% (Collinear) are third-party benchmarks, and Google notes they were "evaluated without guardrails". WebDev Arena: #4 at 1768 (+89 elo). Claims such as "more than 2x uplift" in secure code generation versus Argon and the Chrome team's "more than 10X better" patch quality are Google-internal or partner claims.
Not disclosed: API model name, context window, output limit, knowledge cutoff and tiered pricing are absent from the post, so we do not state them.Price not listed (announced $2.00/$10.00)

ベンチマーク: 公式ブログに表は未掲載のため、当サイトでは集約サイトのスコアを数値として掲載しません（言及する場合は「〜との報道」に留めます）。導入価格 予告 $2/$10（キャッシュ入力95%off）

A new frontier model.

What you can do today: the only route is the Fairwind Program (invitation-based) — no general API or consumer access yet, and you cannot buy at this price yet. Context: 1 million tokens (per the post summary).
Pricing: $2 per 1M input tokens / $10 per 1M output tokens, with cached input at 95% off the input price, is announced as an introductory price for launch; the post does not state that billing has started.
